notes: Authoritative Lightware manufacturer datasheet (HDMI20-OPTC-Series, TX/RX220-Pro), also linked from lightware.com/hdmi20-optc-tx220-pro. Confirms exact rear-panel connectors and labels via the port diagram: 2x HDMI 2.0 (18G) inputs (INPUT 1/2), 1x HDMI 2.0 (18G) output (OUTPUT 2, local monitor feed), 1x Neutrik opticalCON DUO fiber connector (LC duplex), 2x Neutrik etherCON Gigabit Ethernet ports, 1x RS-232 (DB9), 1x Mini USB-B (control only), and IEC C14 AC power inlet with internal AC/DC supply. Enclosure is 1RU height x 1/2 rack width (rack-shelf/standalone mountable, not a full-width 1U chassis) -- rackUnits set to 1 for height but note the half-width form factor. HDMI grade is HDMI 2.0 (18 Gbps, matches hdmi-2.0 tier) per datasheet "HDMI 2.0 (18G)" port labels. Ethernet grade set to eth-1g per "2x Gigabit Ethernet" spec. EtherCON connectors are physically a ruggedized RJ45 variant, mapped to the rj45 connector id per the provided enum (no etherCON option exists in the list). This TX220-Pro variant uses Neutrik opticalCON DUO optics; sibling SKUs (NTQ, FOX, PCN) swap only the optical/power connector types and are not covered here. Front-panel LEDs/LCD/jog-dial control are not physical I/O ports and were omitted.

ports.name: Fiber Output (A/B)
ports.note: Neutrik opticalCON DUO (LC duplex); carries video, 2x Gigabit Ethernet, and RS-232 over a single multimode fiber. Also available in NTQ (OpticalCON Quad), FOX (Fiberfox), and PCN variants with different optical connectors.

ports.name: Gigabit ET 1
ports.note: Physical connector is Neutrik etherCON (ruggedized RJ45 shell), mapped to rj45.

ports.name: Gigabit ET 2
ports.note: Physical connector is Neutrik etherCON (ruggedized RJ45 shell), mapped to rj45.

ports.name: RS-232
ports.note: DB9 connector; bidirectional command injection & pass-through.

ports.name: USB Control
ports.note: Mini USB-B port for LDC software control; not a high-speed data port so no grade set.

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: IEC 60320-C14 inlet, 100-240VAC 50/60Hz, internal AC/DC power supply.
